World map zones (Boss 2026-11-16: boss-farming game; a big map split into zones, one 9-wave run per zone with its boss at wave 9, the first boss kill opens the next zone, each boss drops its own set). pos = zone marker centre on art/ui/world_map/archipelago.png as a fraction of the image (1672x941). journey = data/journeys/<id>.json, empty = not built yet (shown, never playable). order = unlock order: a zone opens when the zone before it has had its boss beaten once (profile.unlocks.zones, server-set).
